description:
Excellent tool for commuters

the aluminium frame is lightweight and at the same time allows better comfort.

The city e-bike allows you an easy daily way to the city, work and school.

Powerful features

our e-bikes with Bafang 250 W brushless gear motor on the rear wheel are quiet and provide pedal support at a speed of up to 25 km/h.

which is equipped with 3 support levels and provides more than enough power for your daily commute to work, a ride on the streets of the city or a walk on your favourite path, and completely waterproof and dustproof.

Muddy roads and rainy weather are nothing to worry about.

Fully integrated battery

40-65 km in pedal support mode (PAS mode). The battery is perfectly integrated into the frame of the bike

which at the same time reduces the weight and maintains the comfortable balance of the bike.

Useful accessories

this e-bike has LED headlights to ensure your safety when riding in the Front and rear mudguards to protect against the elements. The adjustable.

LED display provides the driver with basic information. 7-speed drive system is smooth and comfortable.

WARRANTY & TIPS

We come with a 2-year warranty for bicycle. Solutions are quickly provided by the support team! Each electric bike has been tested before packaging. Solve your worries!

And our bike is 85% pre-assembled. Easy assembly process can be completed on your own.

About Hiland

Hiland is a bicycle brand developed by Joykie. Since 1997, Joykie has delivered bicycle products to more than 80 countries around the world, delivering over 40 million bicycles in total.

Hiland has always been about getting people on the bike and exploring the paths around them. With Hiland, we hope everyone has as much fun cycling as we do.

This bike has an impressive design. Its high-performance configuration allows it to combine speed, comfort, and stability, easily conquering any challenging terrain, aiming to meet the needs of cross-country explorers. This bicycle will bring you an unprecedented off-road adventure experience, redefining your mountain biking experience!
